description: This file provides utility functions for saving data to and loading data from the browser's localStorage, handling serialization and errors gracefully.

methods.name: saveLocal(key, value)
methods.description: Saves a value to localStorage under a specified key after serializing it to JSON, with error handling.

methods.name: loadLocal(key, fallback)
methods.description: Loads and parses a JSON value from localStorage for a given key, returning a fallback value in case of errors or if the key does not exist.
